title: The Untrue 'I Already Brushed'
youtube_title: The Untrue 'I Already Brushed' | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Hiding a dent does not make the dent untrue.
summary: At a kitchen table with jam, butter, and a shared pencil tin, Greta is tangled up with a teeth you said were brushed and almost hides it. Greta tells Ms. Okonkwo the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
